threat_event: Takeover of the business email account; attacker reads client records and sends fake invoices or payment instructions to clients from the real mailbox
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2023 app password on the phone mail app bypasses MFA; MFA by text message only; password reused on other sites; no review of sign-ins or forwarding rules
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 email and file suite; BP-02; BP-03
existing_controls: Text-message MFA on web sign-in; vendor spam filtering
treatment_plan: Delete the app password and block legacy sign-in; authenticator app MFA; password manager with unique passphrases; monthly sign-in and forwarding rule review

threat_event: Payment redirection: a spoofed or compromised carrier, overseas agent, or client email changes bank details and the owner wires freight or duty money to a criminal account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No call-back step for new or changed payees; wires sent on an emailed request; the owner is the only person who sees each payment
existing_controls: Bank MFA and new-payee alerts; the bank's payment fraud module (2026-03)
treatment_plan: Call back a known number before any new or changed payee and log it (POL-01 8.6); wire limit alert at $5,000; tell clients in writing that the business never changes its bank details by email

threat_event: Ransomware on the laptop encrypts the synced records archive and steals client files, including six Social Security number importer IDs and POAs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Archive syncs between laptop and cloud with no independent backup (30-day versions only); saved browser sessions; no security training
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 laptop; SYS-02 records archive; BP-05; BP-01
existing_controls: Built-in antivirus; automatic updates; full-disk encryption (protects only a stolen laptop)
treatment_plan: Independent versioned backup of the archive, tested quarterly; ransomware folder protection; security course; P08 runbook

threat_event: A breach is not reported to the CBP Security Operations Center within 72 hours, or Florida notices are late, because no procedure exists
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident procedure; no list of where importer of record numbers are stored; owner unaware of the 10-business-day update
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; keep a list of the systems that hold importer of record numbers; walkthrough with the IT consultant

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable (illness or injury) or loses the only phone, so no one can file entries, pay duties, or reach the accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only licensed broker; every credential and second factor on one phone; no backup broker agreement; no sealed recovery codes
treatment_plan: Written coverage agreement with the backup broker and standby POAs for willing clients; sealed recovery codes and emergency sheet with the owner's attorney; named records custodian (P05)

threat_event: The bookkeeper's device or the former bookkeeper uses the shared accounting login to view or change client ledgers and bank details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bookkeeper uses the owner's credentials; password unchanged since the bookkeeper changed in 2025; MFA off
treatment_plan: Named bookkeeper account with a limited role; change the owner's password; turn on MFA

threat_event: Client records are disclosed to service providers or the AI assistant vendor without the client's written authorization, and the AI vendor may use them for training
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client terms and POAs do not authorize service providers in writing; consumer AI terms allow training; no vendor list
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-09 AI assistant; SYS-02; SYS-03; client records
existing_controls: Customs software contract with confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Add written client authorization for named service providers to the terms and POA cover letter (confirmed with counsel); vendor list; AI use only on a business plan with no-training terms (P10)

threat_event: An attacker on the home network, through a compromised household device or the router admin page, intercepts traffic or attacks the laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Household devices share the network; router admin password was the factory default (found in P07 on 2026-08-20)
existing_controls: SaaS traffic uses TLS; laptop host firewall on
treatment_plan: Change the router admin password; separate business Wi-Fi network for the laptop, printer, and phone

threat_event: CBP Regulatory Audit finds that scanned records replaced paper originals without the required notice and safeguards, or records cannot be produced within 30 days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Paper originals shredded after scanning since 2024; no alternative storage notice to Regulatory Audit; no written procedure, yearly test, or back-up copy; inconsistent file names
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-10 paper; SYS-02 records archive; BP-05
existing_controls: Records indexed in the customs software by entry number
treatment_plan: Confirm the approach with customs counsel; send the advance notice to Regulatory Audit; written scanning and retrieval procedure; yearly test; back-up copy (R-003 plan)

threat_event: Client documents and IDs in the consumer messaging app or camera roll are exposed (lost phone, cloud photo sync, or a wrong chat)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Overseas agents and some clients send documents by messaging app; copies stay in chats and photos and are not filed
existing_controls: Phone passcode, encryption, and remote wipe
treatment_plan: Save documents to the shipment file the same day and delete them from chats and photos; ask agents to email documents; turn off photo cloud sync for work albums

threat_event: A tariff classification suggested by the AI assistant is used without enough checking and causes underpaid duty, a penalty for the client, or a CBP action against the broker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written review step for AI suggestions; the basis for each classification is not recorded
existing_controls: The owner checks the tariff schedule before filing (not documented)
treatment_plan: Treat AI output as a research lead only; confirm against the tariff schedule and CBP rulings and record the basis in the shipment file (P10)

threat_event: The unwiped 2019 laptop is lost, given away, or recycled with client files still on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No disposal procedure; the laptop was going to a relative
existing_controls: Kept in a closet in the house
treatment_plan: Encrypt, reset, and keep it as the clean spare (P05); record the wipe

threat_event: Customs software outage lasts longer than one business day
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments (RTO 4 hours, SOC 2, P09)
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. The backup broker arrangement in R-005 also covers a long outage

threat_event: Hurricane closes the home office for several days (power and internet out)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single home office; paper records on site
existing_controls: Customs software and email are cloud-hosted; laptop and phone hotspot can work from any location
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Take the laptop and phone when an evacuation order is issued; keep the paper cabinet off the floor

threat_event: An attacker signs in to the owner's CBP portal accounts with a reused password and changes the broker's contact details or views client data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password reuse; recovery options tied to the possibly compromised email account
treatment_plan: Unique passphrase in the password manager; secure the email account first (R-001); check the eCBP point of contact details monthly
